flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4100 then On this checkout page, type 'Grace Hopper' into the Full name field and 'grace@example.com' into the Email field, then click the Place order button.
Wait up to 10 seconds for the page to react.
If the page says there was a problem, @v16:"repeat the same final action once more and wait up to 10 seconds again."
Store the exact text of the confirmation or error message the page shows at the end as {{status_message}} (store 'none' if there is none).
Store the HTTP status code of the last request the page made that saved or changed data (a POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE) as {{last_request_status}} (store 'no response' if that request got no response).
Do not judge the result.
Only record these two values.

last_request_status.code:
writes = [r for r in network.requests() if r.method in ('POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE')]
return str(writes[-1].response_status) if writes and writes[-1].response_status is not None else 'no response'
last_request_status.code_js:
const writes = network.requests().filter(r => ['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'].includes(r.method));
return writes.length && writes[writes.length - 1].responseStatus != null ? String(writes[writes.length - 1].responseStatus) : 'no response';
